243	As it will be in the future to come: "The lion shall eat straw like the ox," and "the wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard lie down with the kid."

244	That is, the Sitra Achra is here in the role of creating the concealing screen.

245	But the vitality is not hers; the vitality belongs to holiness.

246	And what is the second thing the Sitra Achra impresses upon us?

247	The illusion that it creates for us.

248	It creates for us the illusion that its size and its power are what rule, what

249	runs things, and what determines.

250	All this tremendous power of the Sitra Achra that impresses us so much is, as we said before, not

251	the first part, that all it has is not its own,

252	but rather that everything it has borrowed has no existence whatsoever.

253	There is no such thing; it is all illusion.

254	So if there is such an illusion, where does this illusion come from?

255	The Alter Rebe explains that this illusion is a deliberate illusion that comes from the Holy One, blessed be He.

256	The Holy One, blessed be He, wants this illusion.

257	This is the purpose of the Sitra Achra: to produce for us this false impression.

258	Let's see it inside the text.

259	He says: for all its vitality, as

260	we said, is not from itself, Heaven forbid.

261	Its vitality, which is what it has, is not its own, but evidently from the side of holiness.

262	Therefore, from the standpoint of truth, it is totally nullified

263	before holiness.

264	Place it opposite holiness, and you immediately see the truth that all it has is not its own.

265	And as we said before, a little light pushes away much darkness.

266	And it is nullified to holiness like the nullification of darkness before a torch.

267	If so, the opposite question arises, from what we said before: if

268	so, how does it deceive us and create for us a false impression

269	of something so powerful, as if it were the ruler and master of all

270	reality?

271	Here is the deliberate concealment that HaShem created, and what is it?

272	…

273	That with regard to the holiness of the divine soul

274	within a person.

275	The Holy One, blessed be He, who created man and gave him a holy soul, a divine soul,

276	and an animal soul, wanted the Holy One, blessed be He,

277	the animal soul, whose source is in the klipah, to have the power to conceal the light of the holiness of

278	the divine soul.

279	And there is a purpose in this concealment.
